paragraphs: The F-Pace P400 sits at the performance end of the Jaguar SUV range, offering a powerful and responsive driving experience. It uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid technology, delivering 400PS. Fitted across the X761 generation from launch in 2016 to the present day, the AJ300P is part of Jaguar's modern Ingenium engine family and shares its fundamental architecture with the diesel variants in the range.

cards.body: A 3.0L I6 Petrol MHEV engine fitted to the F-Pace P400 — X761 (2016–present).
